reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 8 points better, in a game of about 238 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nuggets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 79 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 212 and 261 total points.
